info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Riebeck Jacket Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Riebeck Jacket Details API allows users to submit detailed information about the Riebeck jacket for catalog management. With this endpoint, retailers and inventory managers can effectively create or update product specifications, including features, sizes, and pricing. Typical consumers are e-commerce platforms and inventory systems that require detailed product listings. This API simplifies the process of managing catalog entries, ensuring accurate and up-to-date product information.

post.summary: Create details for a Riebeck jacket.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to create and submit new details for a Riebeck jacket. Ensure that all required fields are filled out correctly to successfully create the jacket details.

requestBody.description: The request body for creating or updating details of the Riebeck jacket. This body must contain all necessary attributes for the jacket's details, encoded as a JSON object.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the details of the Riebeck jacket.

CreateCatalogRiebeckJacketDetailRequest.title: Riebeck Jacket Order Request

riebeck_jacket_id.description: The unique identifier for the Riebeck jacket being ordered.

requestedBy.description: The name of the person requesting the order.

quantity.description: The quantity of Riebeck jackets to be ordered.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether the order is a priority order.

unitPrice.description: The unit price of a single Riebeck jacket.

CreateCatalogRiebeckJacketDetailRequest.description: This schema defines the structure of the request body for placing an order for a Riebeck jacket.
